email.subject: Update regarding the Product Analyst opening
email.bodyText:
Dear Candidate,

We are writing to let you know that the Product Analyst position (Pune) you applied for has been put on hold due to a change in business priorities, and the requisition is now closed.

We will not be continuing with interviews for this role. Thank you for your patience and interest in Example Ltd.

HR Team, Example Ltd
